hypothesis: inline bounded cells preserve literals and independent facts without duplicate evidence encoding

cell_rule.code_spans: nonempty single-backtick pairs, inner bytes intact
cell_rule.unicode: CRLF, CR, marks/modifiers/variation/ZWJ chains/flag pairs are whole clusters; adjacent non-ASCII letters form runs up to 64 code points

wire: typed string segments inline; evidence bytes appear once, no cell value table
aliases: all supplied evidence, independently of cell presence
atomicity: independently changeable assertions, including shared subjects; allow multiple copy parts per fact; never auto-split responses
stopping: Any failed completed phase ends v15 with insufficient_evidence; no parameter changes or provider calls after offline failure. Complete and retain all three offline datasets for the planned comparison.
formal_comparison: not automatically authorized by minimal live success
